# EvolutionaryReservoirOptimization

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
An algorithm that uses evolutionary strategies to optimize the random weights and topology of a reservoir computing network for improved learning performance. Enables automated design of reservoir topologies without manual tuning, critical for scalable neuromorphic hardware deployment.
